name: skhynix-debate
description: 비공식 인문학 토론 면접 연습 프로그램 (개인 테스트용)

scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json
scripts.chrome:pack: npm run chrome:build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --config electron-builder.chrome.json --publish never
scripts.chrome:dist: npm run chrome:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.chrome.json --publish never
scripts.siwc:build: npm run build && npm run siwc:prepare && node scripts/build-siwc.mjs
scripts.siwc:dist: npm run siwc:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.siwc.json --publish never
scripts.release:candidate: npm run siwc:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.release-candidate.json --publish never
scripts.release:v1: npm run siwc:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.v1.json --publish never
